name: California
seasonNote: Enter from the Arizona desert into San Diego and work south-to-north up the state. The coast is mild year-round; time the Sierra (Yosemite's Tioga Road, the high country) for late spring through fall, and see Death Valley before the summer heat if you can.
summary: The whole Golden State, south to north: San Diego and the SoCal desert, Los Angeles and the Central Coast, the eastern parks of Death Valley, Sequoia, and Yosemite, the Monterey coast and Big Sur, San Francisco and the capital, the wine country and Lake Tahoe, and the volcanic north through Lassen, Mendocino, and the tallest trees on earth at Redwood.
